hypothesis: The exact v25 HIP-3 entry recipes combined with the deployed fixed 80-bps stop, no target, opposite-intent close, and 24-hour maximum hold may behave differently from the previously rejected source lifecycles, but a single-provider independent-asset 15-minute bar approximation can only diagnose that possibility and cannot establish live portfolio edge.
decision: Supersede revision 7 to record the bounded v25 lifecycle bar diagnostic. Recipe parity is exact for all four production HIP-3 provider objects and the final chronological holdouts remain sealed. The index breakout approximation produced +$0.92 nominal and -$0.12 stress on 30 validation trades; index Swing/HA produced +$1.75 nominal and approximately flat -$0.003 stress on 29 to 30 validation trades. Commodity breakout produced +$0.10 nominal but -$9.59 stress, while commodity Swing/HA lost under both modes. No route demonstrates positive aggregate stress robustness. Retain v25 only as the already operator-authorized ungated live-research canary; do not promote, resize, reroute, or restart execution from this diagnostic. The next evidentiary step is actual canary reconciliation or a combined-priority, shared-account, wall-clock event replay.
falsifier: This bar-level assessment is updated by a routed wall-clock replay that reproduces combined Swing-versus-Breakout priority, shared account sizing, venue quantity and trigger rounding, authoritative fees, executable IOC quotes, and first-poll timeout timing, or by sufficient exact v25 live lifecycles reconciled to venue fills. Consistent positive after-cost outcomes under nominal and stress conditions would increase confidence; continued negative live outcomes, materially different routing, or discrepancies between generated intents and venue fills would falsify any inference of edge from the nominal bar results.
limitations: This is not live parity: each provider and asset is evaluated independently rather than through v25's combined provider priority and shared account allocation.
Fifteen-minute bar timing approximates the live wall-clock timer and one-minute IOC close poll; bar gaps and same-bar ordering can change exits.
Historical quantities, stop triggers, and fills are not rounded to every venue increment, and midpoint OHLC cannot prove the trigger reference or executable event sequence.
Current fee inputs are sensitivity assumptions; GOLD's historical effective growth-mode fee state remains unresolved.
The report compares competing providers independently, so their PnL values must not be summed into a deployable portfolio result.
The final chronological holdouts remain sealed and were not accessed to rescue or promote any route.
Report-only evidence does not pause, gate, retune, resize, reroute, or otherwise mutate the running live backend.
A nominally positive result with a non-positive stress result is insufficient evidence of repeatable after-cost edge.
Fresh live canary lifecycles remain necessary to measure actual acknowledgements, fees, slippage, stops, route collisions, and timeout behavior.
